--- text
[alpha] beta
--- keys
Cmd+C DoubleClick(1,8) Cmd+V
--- expect
alpha alpha|
--- note
Paste overwrites an active selection; it does not insert beside it. Cmd+C
captures "alpha". The double click at column 8 lands inside "beta" and selects
that whole word. Pasting onto that non-empty selection replaces "beta" with
"alpha", leaving the caret at the end of the pasted text. If paste inserted at
the caret instead of replacing, the result would keep "beta" and read
"alpha alphabeta".
